answer.conflict_group_limit: These are product-owned groups over registered choice IDs. They do not define a general conflict algorithm for arbitrary configuration keys. In particular, the three var categories are described as independent editorconfig categories; their choice group alone does not prove that corresponding external keys cannot coexist.

omitted_boolean_interpretation.known_choice_complete_data: For a registered choice in this Complete vocabulary, absence from a declared Boolean property_set whose map has complete coverage and exactly-one cardinality means false for that Boolean property. For example, wrap-splittable-expressions is absent from byte_divergent, so byte_divergent is false; its presence in corpus_endorsed means true.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.unknown_id: No Boolean value can be inferred for an ID that is not a registered member. The complete 17-member scope permits saying it is not registered here, not that its properties are false.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.incomplete_data: If the vocabulary or map coverage were incomplete, omission would be unknown rather than false unless another explicit fact resolved it.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.unavailable_property: If a property is unavailable or undeclared, omission gives no Boolean value. A property_set may only be interpreted for a declared available Boolean map in its stated scope.
